content.value_statement: Test suites can pass while hiding weak coverage, flaky behavior, and costly maintenance. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical test quality reviews.
actual_capabilities: Reviews test structure, readability, maintainability, reliability, and speed.
Uses a bundled checklist to score common test quality dimensions.
Provides a report template for documenting findings and recommendations.
Runs an optional local metrics script for JavaScript and TypeScript test suites.
Explains framework-agnostic anti-patterns such as flaky assertions and over-mocking.
Guides coverage and mutation testing interpretation.
limitations: It does not replace framework-specific testing skills for detailed syntax guidance.
The metrics script focuses on common JavaScript and TypeScript test file names.
Coverage and mutation scores require external tools or user-provided reports.
Recommendations depend on the project files and test data available for review.

use_cases.title: Review a Test Suite Before Release
use_cases.description: Assess reliability, coverage, and maintainability before shipping a major change.

use_cases.title: Improve Weak or Flaky Tests
use_cases.description: Find timing issues, shared state, poor assertions, and other causes of unstable tests.

use_cases.title: Create a Quality Report
use_cases.description: Use the checklist and report template to summarize issues, scores, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Test Quality Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one project or folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the test quality in this project. Focus on readability, reliability, maintainability, and obvious missing coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Coverage Gap Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a coverage report and related tests.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this coverage report and the related tests. Identify important gaps, weak assertions, and the highest priority test cases to add.

prompt_templates.title: Flakiness and Anti-Pattern Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigate unstable or hard to maintain tests.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these tests for flakiness and anti-patterns. Look for timing dependencies, shared state, over-mocking, hidden dependencies, and unclear assertions.

prompt_templates.title: Full Quality Assessment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with metrics and reporting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full test quality assessment. Use available metrics, inspect representative tests, score each quality dimension, and produce prioritized remediation steps.

output_examples.input: A team asks for a review of unit and integration tests before a release.
output: Overall quality score with strengths and weak areas.
Priority findings for flaky tests, unclear assertions, and missing edge cases.
Specific recommendations grouped by release risk and effort.

output_examples.input: A coverage report shows high statement coverage but low branch coverage.
output: Explanation of why high statement coverage may still miss important behavior.
A list of untested branches and suggested scenarios.
Guidance for adding focused tests without increasing maintenance cost.

output_examples.input: A QA engineer needs a repeatable test quality checklist.
output: A structured checklist covering organization, reliability, maintainability, and performance.
Action items that can be tracked after the review.

best_practices: Provide the relevant tests, source files, and coverage reports together.
Ask for prioritized findings when release timing or review capacity is limited.
Run the metrics script only in a trusted local project directory.
anti_patterns: Using coverage percentage alone as proof of strong tests.
Requesting framework-specific syntax changes from this framework-agnostic skill.
Ignoring flaky tests because they pass after reruns.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes test quality, including structure, coverage quality, reliability, maintainability, performance, and common anti-patterns.

faq.question: Does it support my test framework?
faq.answer: It provides framework-agnostic guidance. Use a framework-specific testing skill when you need exact Jest, Vitest, Playwright, or Mocha syntax.

faq.question: Can it calculate metrics automatically?
faq.answer: It includes an optional shell script that counts common JavaScript and TypeScript test files, test blocks, ratios, and patterns locally.

faq.question: Does it replace coverage tools?
faq.answer: No. It interprets coverage and quality signals, but coverage data must come from tools such as Jest, Istanbul, c8, or Stryker.

faq.question: What files should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide representative tests, related source files, coverage reports, mutation results if available, and any known flaky test history.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to run?
faq.answer: The reviewed files show local read-only analysis patterns and documentation. The bundled script should be run only in trusted project directories.
